annotations.title: Hiring plan with dates and cost

description: Hiring plan with dates and cost — Headcount plan from a role list. Offline: staggered req-open, offer and start dates (start moved to a Monday and past US federal holidays), loaded annual cost, first-year prorated cost, headcount and cost by quarter, budget variance. AI: must-haves, nice-to-haves, interview loop, sourcing channels and risk per role plus hiring sequence. Params: roles (required, e.g. 2x Backend Engineer:160000; 1x Product Designer:130000), start=YYYY-MM-DD, timeToFill=45, notice=14, stagger=21, load=1.25 (or 25 for percent), budget, startOnMonday=true, context. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: ai_hiring_plan
